ruleDefinitions.name: Use Short Name Path in Command Line
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid command-line detection

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~1\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\~2\\\\.*")) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Dism\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\cleanmgr\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\GPSoftware\\Directory\ Opus\\dopus\.exe") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WebEx\\\\WebexHost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\thor\\\\thor64\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\veam\\\.backup\\\.shell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\winget\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Everything\\\\Everything\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\aurora\\-agent\\-64\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\aurora\\-agent\\\.exe$")) OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\WinGet\\\\.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\appdata\\\\local\\\\webex\\\\webex64\\\\meetings\\\\wbxreport\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Git\\\\post\\-install\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Git\\\\cmd\\\\scalar\\\.exe.*"))))
